item.title: COMING Thursday, Nov 12 | Bluegrass and BBQ ft. The JackTown Ramblers — Sun Nov 8 — The Farm – A Gathering Place
item.description:
Thursday November 12 | Doors open at 5pm, Dinner 6 pm, Music 7-9 pm | $59.95 Event Details and Tickets Smoked BBQ, warm cornbread, and the JackTown Ramblers playing all night, fifteen minutes from downtown Asheville.
When the evenings turn cool in the mountains, this is the kind of dinner we want to gather around. Smoked BBQ chicken. Fried catfish with remoulade. Cornbread muffins with honey butter, still warm from the oven. Banana pudding to finish. It’s the food these hills are known for, cooked by the Farm Kitchen and passed down the table.
Live bluegrass from the JackTown Ramblers The JackTown Ramblers are a four-piece string band from western North Carolina. Their sets blend traditional bluegrass with swing tunes, a little gypsy jazz, and songs of their own, and they’ve become a familiar name on stages across the region.

item.title: AT from NOC to Wesser Bald 13.5 mile Fitness Hike. — Wed Nov 11, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **DISTANCE:** 13.1 miles. **ELEVATION GAIN**: Approximately 3464'. ' [https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/north-carolina/wesser-bald-via-appalachian-trail](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/north-carolina/wesser-bald-via-appalachian-trail) This hike begins across the street from the NOC complex. We will hike mostly up, up up, to the viewing tower on Wesser Bald. **Hike** **Highlights** include many beautiful views of mountains close in and far away. We will eat lunch at the Wesser Bald tower while we soak in the long range views before heading back down the trail. For those interested, there is a restaurant and bar at the NOC for after hike refreshments.
**PACE**: We hike at a steady pace averaging 2.5 - 3mph with brief regrouping at trail intersections. This is a strenuos hike for conditioned hikers. Please know your hiking abilities and be capable of hiking this distance, elevation, and pace, BEFORE SIGNING ON.
**DOGS:** Well-behaved dogs are welcome.

item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Nov 15, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.
Source: Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Ashevi

item.title: Sunday Sounds | Diego Vázquez — Sun Dec 6, 12:00 PM — Asheville Art Museum
item.description:
Join us for an afternoon of music and art in the Museum. With a soundscape of piano music, we invite you to experience artwork in the galleries in a more emotional and sensory way. ABOUT THE MUSICIAN Diego Vázquez is a Spanish pianist from Madrid now based in Asheville who views music as a way to understand and express emotions beyond words. He began playing at age four and developed a strong classical foundation, later expanding into pop and musical theater. After years of studying in Spain, he now pursues music independently in the United States, performing as a chapel pianist, choir member, and orchestra musician while also learning the organ. His cross-cultural journey shapes a deeply expressive style, with music focused on connection rather than perfection. RESERVE TICKETS NOW
Source: Asheville Art Museum
